name: Summer is a Village
overview: A reality show about the re-education of obstinate zoomers on vacation in the Russian countryside. Popular Internet heroes will switch online to survival mode, moving from a chic TikTok house to a creepy village hut. Kirill Volik, Lera Kantur, Ilya Milokhin, the twins Katya and Nastya Leshchinsky and Kristina Fedosova will face a harsh rural life, explain to local residents the difference between the concepts of "crash" and "clash", learn how to cook food over a campfire, have fun without a smartphone and help others not only for the sake of hype content. Fueled by extreme experiences, in the process of exploring the "wild" locations, the guys will uncover a lot of inner workings of tiktok life, discuss gossip about each other and even get involved in a love triangle.
